title: Advanced Performance Marketing & Growth Systems
description: Learn paid advertising, Google & Facebook ad campaigns, website analytics, and customer acquisition step-by-step.
capstoneDesc: Real Meta & Google Ads Budget Simulator ($10k test fund)

lessons.title: Funnel Economics & CAC/LTV Mechanics
overview: Master customer acquisition economics, payback periods, and margin calculations across B2B and D2C funnels.
Analyze customer retention data to establish profitable ad spend thresholds.

takeaways.title: Unit Economics
takeaways.desc: Calculate Blended vs Paid CAC accurately across multi-touch touchpoints.

takeaways.title: Payback Velocity
takeaways.desc: Optimize ad spend based on 30, 60, and 90-day cash recovery cycles.

lessons.title: Audience Segmentation & Persona Engineering
overview: Build granular customer ICP profiles and map emotional triggers to specific advertising angles.
Leverage first-party data exports for high-precision seed lists.

takeaways.title: Psychographic Modeling
takeaways.desc: Identify the top 3 friction points preventing customer purchase.

takeaways.title: Seed List Cleansing
takeaways.desc: Filter high-LTV customer records to prevent lookalike dilution.

lessons.title: Auction Theory & eCPM Optimization
overview: Understand Facebook's auction formula: Total Value = Bid × Estimated Action Rate + User Value.
Structure broad-targeting campaigns that let the algorithm self-optimize efficiently.

takeaways.title: Creative as Targeting
takeaways.desc: Use specific hook formats to filter intent rather than micro-interest layering.

takeaways.title: Bid Cap Tactics
takeaways.desc: Deploy manual bid caps during peak seasonal events to protect ROAS.

lessons.title: Creative Fatigue Cycling & Dynamic Testing
overview: Implement 3:2:2 Dynamic Creative Testing frameworks to identify winning hooks, copy, and visual formats.
Rotate ad variants systematically before frequency saturation degrades conversion efficiency.

takeaways.title: Hook-Hold Ratios
takeaways.desc: Diagnose video creative using 3-second hook drop-off vs 50% watch time.

takeaways.title: Scaling Horizontal
takeaways.desc: Scale winning post IDs into consolidated CBO campaigns without reset.

lessons.title: Intent Capture with Google Search Architecture
overview: Structure single-theme ad groups (STAGs) with exact and phrase match intent layers.
Eliminate ad spend waste using exhaustive negative keyword lists and search term mining.

takeaways.title: Search Term Mining
takeaways.desc: Routinely convert high-converting search queries into isolated exact match keywords.

takeaways.title: Quality Score Gains
takeaways.desc: Align landing page H1s with ad copy to lower cost per click by up to 35%.

lessons.title: Performance Max Campaign Orchestration
overview: Feed high-quality asset groups, customer match signals, and final URL expansion rules to PMax.
Audit placement reports to prevent brand cannibalization.

takeaways.title: Audience Signals
takeaways.desc: Guide Google AI with custom intent segments and in-market buyer lists.

takeaways.title: Brand Exclusions
takeaways.desc: Always apply brand exclusion lists to PMax to measure true incremental acquisition.

lessons.title: Server-Side Tagging & Conversions API (CAPI)
overview: Bypass browser ad-blockers and iOS privacy restrictions with Google Tag Manager Server-Side setup.
Transmit hashed user parameters to achieve Event Match Quality scores above 8.5.

takeaways.title: Event Match Quality
takeaways.desc: Send external_id, fbp, and fbc cookies alongside email hashes.

takeaways.title: Deduplication Rules
takeaways.desc: Coordinate event_id across browser pixel and server CAPI events.

lessons.title: Marketing Mix Modeling & Incremental Testing
overview: Conduct geo-split lift tests to measure true incrementality over baseline organic sales.
Build automated SQL dashboards to reconcile CRM revenue with ad platform metrics.

takeaways.title: Holdout Groups
takeaways.desc: Blackout advertising in specific target regions to calculate genuine ROAS lift.

takeaways.title: Attribution Blending
takeaways.desc: Combine first-touch, last-touch, and Shapley data-driven models.
